plainTranslation: A's drive meets B's feelings. The conjunction fuses them - intense and inseparable.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Synced from authored synastry bundle synastry-authored__19_ (2).json.
summaryDeep: Their initiative, urgency, directness, and temper sit right on top of your feelings, needs, and sense of safety. This is one of the closest contacts between you, strong and constant, energizing at its best and a lot to hold at its worst. Let the closeness feed you without letting it run you.
tension: The problem is that the same closeness can make everything louder. A small comment can feel personal. A mood can turn into an argument. One of you may react first and understand later. If you are not careful, the relationship can start to run on the rush of fighting, making up, and calling the whole thing passion.
advice: Notice the moment your body starts to heat up. That is where you still have a choice. The intensity can be beautiful, but it should not be in charge of the relationship.
summaryShort: Their initiative, urgency, directness, and temper sit right on top of your feelings, needs, and sense of safety.
